title: CORA-Diff: Confidence-Oriented Residual Acceptance for Efficient Diffusion Language Model Inference
abstract: arXiv:2608.11235v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) update many tokens in parallel, yet practical decoders often use a fixed denoising horizon. Many predictions stabilize early, but blockwise decoding continues until all positions are resolved, causing repeated dense forward passes. Existing accelerators often rely on learned filters, modified scores, dependency models, or cache-specific mechanisms. We ask whether native trajectory signals can identify residual positions likely to match the deterministic dense endpoint. We propose CORA-Diff, a training-free method that preserves the original transfer rule and applies confidence-and-persistence gating only to positions that rule leaves unresolved. Accepted tokens remain visible as context, and the block terminates once all positions are resolved. This requires no backbone change, learned acceptance model, or logit modification. Our theory explains why high-confidence, persistent predictions are more likely

translated_title: CORA-Diff：面向高效扩散语言模型推理的置信度导向残差接受方法
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）并行更新多个token，但实际解码器通常使用固定的去噪步数。许多预测在早期就趋于稳定，但分块解码会持续进行直到所有位置都被解析，导致重复的密集前向传播。现有的加速方法通常依赖学习过滤器、修改后的分数、依赖模型或特定缓存机制。我们探讨了是否可以利用原生轨迹信号来识别可能与确定性密集端点匹配的残差位置。我们提出CORA-Diff，一种无需训练的方法，它保留原始转移规则，并仅对规则未解决的位置应用置信度和持续性门控。被接受的token作为上下文保持可见，一旦所有位置都被解析，块处理即终止。这不需要改变骨干网络、学习接受模型或修改logits。我们的理论解释了为什么高置信度、持续性的预测更可能匹配最终结果。
tldr: 提出一种无需训练的CORA-Diff方法，利用原生轨迹信号中的置信度和持续性门控来识别并仅处理未稳定的残差位置，从而在不修改模型或得分的情况下加速扩散语言模型推理。
en_tdlr: We propose CORA-Diff, a training-free method that accelerates diffusion language model inference by applying confidence-and-persistence gating only to unresolved residual positions, preserving the original transfer rule without model or logit modifications.
